name: Ooyama Tarou
source:
Born on September 2, 1989.
His nickname is "Taro P." He is a huge fan of Hijiri Ayaka and is the president of her fan club. He is a goofball and sometimes goes out of control for Ayaka's sake, but he is an honest person. He is also a fan of the school's legendary cavalry team and treasures his photos of them. Although his grades are not high, he has a proactive presence in class.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
